name.fr-FR: Remarques sur Dupin et sur la Mystique Cité de Dieu
name.en-US: Remarks on Dupin and on the Mystical City of God
name.pt-BR: Observações sobre Dupin e sobre a Mística Cidade de Deus

description.fr-FR: Mémoire de Bossuet sur ce qu’il faut corriger dans la Nouvelle bibliothèque des auteurs ecclésiastiques de Louis Ellies Dupin (1691-1693), remarques sur son histoire des conciles d’Éphèse et de Chalcédoine, et remarques sur la Mystique Cité de Dieu de Marie d’Agreda. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: Bossuet’s memorandum on what needs correcting in Louis Ellies Dupin’s New Library of Ecclesiastical Authors (1691-93), remarks on his history of the councils of Ephesus and Chalcedon, and remarks on the Mystical City of God by Mary of Ágreda. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Memória de Bossuet sobre o que se deve corrigir na Nova biblioteca dos autores eclesiásticos de Louis Ellies Dupin (1691-1693), observações sobre sua história dos concílios de Éfeso e Calcedônia, e observações sobre a Mística Cidade de Deus de Maria de Ágreda. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XX, pages 014-019 (page 016 not captured). The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
